Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

World of Bits: An Open-Domain Platform for Web-Based Agents (PMLR-v70-shi17a-2017) · paper method: In FormWoB, an unseen HTTP request terminates the episode with zero reward.

cohort7.claim.worldbits.cached-reward

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Proxy records demonstration HTTP requests/responses; reward otherwise measures the fraction of request key-value pairs matching demonstrations. This is an offline approximation, not a live-site task success guarantee.
